evidence.note: Dozens of ~1 px light-grey spokes fan from small agent dots to the package mirror; thin, low-contrast lines that compression would smear or erase.
At the small viewer size the spokes become faint grey hatching and the agent dots shrink to a few pixels with thin outlines.
'PUBLIC INTERNET' label, globe icon and arrow are very pale grey on the paper background: small faint text and hairline strokes.
'PUBLIC INTERNET' label is small and barely distinguishable from the background at the small size.
Title, timeline items and callout text are large with good contrast; background is flat colour with no texture or grain.

rationale: Type in the title, timeline and callouts is generous and the paper feel comes from colour only, matching the pass anchor. However, the central diagram relies on many 1 px pale-grey spokes and tiny outlined dots, and the 'PUBLIC INTERNET' zone uses small, very faint text and thin strokes. Those hairlines and low-contrast labels are exactly what video compression and a small window would erase, so the fail descriptor fits.
